subject: Culture
title: Denim's Journey
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Denim's Journey.

hook.text: Levi Strauss patented riveted jeans in 1873 for gold miners. Now they're the world's most universal garment.

buildup.text: Denim originated in Nîmes, France—'de Nîmes.' The fabric crossed the Atlantic as workwear for American laborers.

discovery.text: James Dean and Marlon Brando made jeans a symbol of youth rebellion in the 1950s.

twist.text: In the Soviet Union, jeans were black market contraband worth a month's salary. Denim symbolized Western freedom.

climax.text: Today a pair of jeans uses 7,500 liters of water to produce. Fashion's icon is also its environmental problem.

punchline.text: Jeans went from work pants to the world's most loaded symbol.

details.summary: Denim traveled from Genoa workwear to global fashion staple in two centuries. Originally made for miners and laborers, jeans became symbols of rebellion through James Dean, then luxury through designer labels. A single fabric tells the story of modern class and culture.
details.whyItMatters: Denim's transformation from labor clothing to luxury fashion illustrates how garments acquire and shed class associations, reflecting broader cultural shifts.
takeaways: Denim originated as durable workwear for Gold Rush miners
James Dean and Marlon Brando made jeans symbols of youth rebellion
Designer jeans created a new premium denim category in the 1970s

faq.question: Who invented blue jeans?
faq.answer: Levi Strauss and tailor Jacob Davis patented riveted denim work pants in 1873. Strauss supplied the fabric and Davis added copper rivets at stress points. Originally called 'waist overalls,' they were designed for miners and laborers who needed extremely durable clothing.

faq.question: How did jeans become a fashion item?
faq.answer: In the 1950s, films like Rebel Without a Cause and The Wild One made jeans symbols of youthful rebellion. Schools banned them, increasing their appeal. By the 1970s, designers like Calvin Klein and Gloria Vanderbilt created premium jeans, transforming workwear into fashion.
